subject: ACME — Invoice estimate & cost model (follow-up)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Kelly Rivera <kelly.rivera@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-04-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME — Invoice estimate & cost model (follow-up)

Hi Alex / Kelly,

Thanks again for your time today — good conversation on expected traffic shape and latency SLOs. Quick recap + next steps so we have alignment: 

- Assumptions from the call: ~15k concurrent users, peak 250 reqs/sec, average prompt length ~1.2k tokens, avg completion ~800 tokens. Expected monthly usage ~400M input tokens + 240M output tokens (~640M total).
- Proposed model: Redwood-served Llama-3-70B-quant (production variant); fallback to Llama-3-33B for batch/low-priority jobs.
- Engineering asks: sample trace for 5 typical flows (we can ingest non-PII traces) and a target SLA for 95th pct latency.

Attached an initial invoice estimate and a short cost model breakdown. Highlights:
- Target unit economics: we used $X / 1M tokens as our base for the estimate (see sheet).
- Budget range check: we modeled three bands (conservative / expected / aggressive).

Attachments: redwood_invoice_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_cost_model_breakdown_v1.pdf (summary).

Next steps:
1) Review the attached estimate and confirm whether the traffic assumptions look right for your initial rollout.
2) If numbers look OK, I’ll produce a Dedicated capacity proposal (with reserved commit discounts) and a final invoice.
3) Procurement: Kelly, would you like an MSA/PO template or should I loop Legal?

Happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up if helpful — I’ve left some availability tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.example | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>
Cc: Kelly Rivera <kelly.rivera@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME — Invoice estimate & cost model (follow-up)

Thanks Sean — good summary. A few quick clarifying questions for the cost model so we can validate internally: 

1) The 640M token/mo figure — is that billable tokens (input+output) or just model tokens? We track both but need to make sure we align to your billing unit.
2) What per-1M token rate did you use for Llama-3-70B-quant vs the 33B fallback? Can you show the blended $/1M tokens you used in the "expected" band?
3) Do your estimates account for prefix/KV caching on repeated prompts? That could materially reduce billable tokens for us on assisted flows.
4) Budget range question: our finance lead is targeting ~$X-2X total for the first 6 months — can you show a committed-discount scenario (monthly reserved commit) vs pay-as-you-go?

If you can reply with those numbers and an updated sheet we can move to procurement. Kelly — FYI in case we need a PO template.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Sr. Product Manager, Conversational AI
Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

Date: 2027-04-12T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME — Invoice estimate & cost model (follow-up)

Alex / Kelly — thanks for the questions. Short answers + attached updated artifacts (v2). Full assumptions are listed in the sheet.

1) Billing unit: Redwood bills measured tokens = input + output tokens. The estimate I sent was total measured tokens. I’ve added a column in v2 that shows input vs output and the billable total.

2) Per-1M token rates used (pre-discount):
- Llama-3-70B-quant (prod variant): $28 / 1M tokens
- Llama-3-33B (fallback): $9 / 1M tokens
Blended rate in the "expected" band: $21.50 / 1M tokens (weighted by modeled split of 85% 70B / 15% 33B).

3) Caching: we modeled a conservative 10% effective reduction on billable tokens for the assisted flows (prefix caching). If you can share a sample of repeated prompt traces we can refine that to 25-40% in some flows.

4) Committed vs PAYG: attached v2 includes three pricing scenarios: PAYG (no commit), 6-month reserved commit (10% discount on unit rate), 12-month reserved commit (18% discount). I’ve also added a column for estimated monthly invoice and a sample invoice file for a 12-month commit.

Key numbers (expected band):
- Monthly billable tokens: 640,000,000
- Blended unit rate (PAYG): $21.50 / 1M tokens
- Monthly cost (PAYG expected): $13,760
- Monthly cost (6mo commit -10%): $12,384
- Monthly cost (12mo commit -18%): $11,299.20

I attached: redwood_invoice_estimate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) and acme_cost_model_breakdown_v2.pdf (detailed assumptions). I also included a short text file with a link to the interactive pricing calculator.

Next steps:
- Alex/Kelly: confirm the token assumptions or share sample traces.
- If acceptable, I’ll draft a Dedicated proposal with commit terms and an MSA for procurement.

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the sheet — can do 30 mins later today or tomorrow morning.

Cheers,
Sean
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
